gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the VIOFO A329S's battery-voltage cut-off works only with VIOFO's HK6 hardwire kit ($25.99 on viofo.com, 2026-11-21), and that the older HK4 cannot do the voltage-based switch into the A329S's low-power parking mode.
standout_why: Compared against productbible.com (cited), digitalcameraworld.com A329S 3CH review (cited), gearsentials.com A329S vs N4 Pro S (cited), dashcamtalk.com/best-dash-cams (cited) and Vantrue's own store. Product Bible names a kit only for the VIOFO T330 (HK6-F) and none for the A329S. Digital Camera World says only 'Parking mode: Yes, hardwiring required.' Gearsentials says 'HK4 or HK6 hardwire kit sold separately', which suggests either kit works equally. DashCamTalk's best-of page mentions no hardwire kit, cut-off voltage or hybrid parking. None of them says HK4 owners lose the A329S's voltage cut-off. None gives the 70mai T800's 4G region split (UP05 US only, UP04 Australia/Korea only). None checks which Vantrue hardwire kits list the N4 Pro S. Product Bible does already say the N4 Pro S takes Vantrue's $149.99 LTE module, so that cell is not new. vortexradar.com (cited) returned HTTP 403 and was not compared.
decides: It confirms the pick rather than changing it. VIOFO's own pages say that using the A329S 3CH's headline multi-day parking safely (voltage cut-off and voltage-triggered hybrid mode) means adding the $25.99 HK6. The older HK4 a returning VIOFO owner may already have will not do it. For the Vantrue N4 Pro S, the maker's documents name a parking-mode kit (the $29.99 Voltage Display Hardwire Kit lists the N4 Pro S by name) and an LTE module ($149.99, lists 'N4PS'). Avoid Vantrue's 5-Level kit: its own listing contradicts itself about the N4 Pro S. For a US buyer of the 70mai T800, only the UP05 kit gives 4G, and the UP04 sold in other regions will not. The A329S stays the quality pick and the N4 Pro S the value pick. This angle tells the page exactly which add-on each one needs.

findings.label: Hardwire kit needed for cut-off voltage and voltage-based hybrid parking
findings.value: HK6 only. VIOFO: 'This mode requires the HK6 — the older HK4 does not support voltage-based switching.' The HK6 is also required for the Bluetooth battery-voltage overlay.
findings.source_title: VIOFO Type-C HK6 ACC Hardwire Kit for A329S/A229/A119M Pro Series
findings.note: I read the product text from viofo.com's store data with storecheck search. A direct page open hit HTTP 429. VIOFO's page says the HK6 is 'required to unlock... Hybrid Parking Mode, Cut-off Voltage protection, and real-time Bluetooth battery voltage monitoring.'

findings.label: HK6 hardwire kit price
findings.source_title: VIOFO Type-C HK6 ACC Hardwire Kit for A329S/A229/A119M Pro Series
findings.note: viofo.com US store via storecheck search. The page states 12–24 V vehicle input.

findings.label: Cut-off voltage: which kits support it (maker blog)
findings.value: HK6 only ('Cut-off Voltage is only available with the HK6 hardwire kit'). Cut-off time works with either HK4 or HK6. Low Power Impact standby draws as little as 0.24 W / 20 mA at 12 V.
findings.source_title: Highlights of the A329S Series: What Are Low Power Impact Mode & Hybrid Parking Mode? (VIOFO, 2025-12-24)
findings.note: This is VIOFO's own post and confirms the product-page wording. The A329S product listing says 'under 40mA at 12.6V' for the same mode.

findings.label: Price, and what each camera sees and records with all three running
findings.value: $519.99. Front 4K at 30 fps, 210° fisheye cabin 2K (2560×1440) with IR, rear 2K. All three are Sony STARVIS 2 (cabin IMX675). Front 4K at 60 fps only in 1- or 2-channel setups.
findings.source_title: VIOFO A329S 3CH First 4K 30FPS Front+2K Wide 210° FOV Fisheye Cabin+2K Rear Dash Cam
findings.note: Price and listing text from viofo.com store data via storecheck search; direct open hit HTTP 429. The listing title reads '4K 30FPS Front'. Digital Camera World (2026-10-26) states the front records 60 fps only 'when the interior camera isn't in use'.

findings.label: Replacement or add-on camera compatibility
findings.value: RC420 2K rear camera ($89.99, 6 m coax cable) fits all A329, A329S and A329T front units. RCC360 2K 210° IR cabin camera ($99.99) fits A329S, A329SW, T330 and T340.
findings.source_title: VIOFO RCC360 2K HDR Fisheye Cabin Cam ... for A329S/A329SW/T330/T340
findings.note: Both listings come from the viofo.com storecheck search. The RC420 listing is at https://www.viofo.com/products/rc420-2k-hdr-rear-camera-with-6m-cable-and-adhesive-sticker-for-viofo-a329-a329s-a329t-series. The A329S 1CH listing says it can be expanded to 3CH with no firmware change.

findings.label: Storage
findings.value: microSD up to 512 GB. External SSD up to 4 TB over USB 3.0.
findings.source_title: VIOFO A329S 1CH 4K 60FPS Wi-Fi 6 HDR Dash Cam
findings.note: Stated on the A329S 1CH listing, which shares the platform with the 3CH. viofo.com storecheck search.

findings.label: Hardwire kit that names the N4 Pro S
findings.value: Vantrue Voltage Display Hardwire Kit, $29.99 (was $34.99). Its compatibility list includes 'N4 Pro S'. It takes 12–24 V and offers 11.6/23.6 V, 12/24 V and 12.4/24.4 V cut-off settings.
findings.note: vantrue.com store data via storecheck search. Vantrue's Voltage Display OBD Cable ($29.99) also lists the N4 Pro S.

findings.label: Kit listing that contradicts itself
findings.value: Vantrue's 5-Level Adjustable Hardwire Kit ($34.99) is titled 'for N4S, N4 Pro S, N5 S...'. The same listing then says 'it only work for N4 N5 N4 Pro and E1, E2, S2-2CH, S2-3CH, N2S, X4S, T3', which leaves out the N4 Pro S.
findings.note: vantrue.com store data via storecheck search. Because of the contradiction, recommend the Voltage Display kit for the N4 Pro S.

findings.label: LTE module compatibility and price
findings.value: Vantrue 4G LTE Module with SIM Card, $149.99. Listed for 'S1 Pro | N2X | E360 | E360 Ace | S1 Pro Max | N4S | E1 Pro | N5S | N4PS'. The SIM comes with 300 MB of data, and the owner tops it up after that. LTE Cat 4.
findings.source_title: Vantrue 4G LTE Module with SIM Card
findings.note: vantrue.com store data via storecheck search; direct open hit HTTP 429. Product Bible already gives the $149.99 module for the N4 Pro S.

findings.label: Price, camera layout and storage
findings.value: $279.99 (list $469.99). 3 channels: 4K front, 1080p cabin, 2.5K rear. Three Sony STARVIS 2 sensors, supercapacitor, built-in GPS, microSD up to 1 TB. A 29.5 ft rear cable sold separately ($15.99) lists the N4PS.
findings.note: vantrue.com store data via storecheck search. The rear cable listing is at https://www.vantrue.com/products/29-5ft-rear-camera-cable-for-n4-pro-s1-pro-e3.

findings.label: Parking and 4G hardwire kit by region
findings.value: UP03 gives parking mode only and works in all countries. UP05 gives 4G and is 'only for the US (AT&T Carrier recommended)'. UP04 gives 4G and is 'only for Australia ... and Korea'. Both 4G kits are listed for the A510, A810, Omni, 4K Omni and 4K T800. The listing price is $27.99.
findings.source_title: 70mai Hardwire Kit with USB Type-C Port
findings.note: 70mai.store store data via storecheck search; product open hit HTTP 429. $27.99 is the listing's headline price. Per-variant prices for UP03 and UP05 were not read.

findings.label: Maker bundle with the parking kit included
findings.value: 3-Channel Pro Setup: 4K T800 front (interior camera built in) + RC41 rear + hardwire kit + 512 GB microSD, $322.49
findings.source_title: 3-Channel Pro Setup: 4K T800 Front Cam + Rear Cam + Memory Card + Hardwire Kit
findings.note: 70mai.store via storecheck search. The listing does not say whether the bundled kit is the UP03 or the UP05.
